content.text: Your browser does not support the video tag. The ASU academic experience As the New American University, ASU offers a world-class academic experience designed for every learner. The New American UniversityAt Arizona State University, you will experience a transformative academic journey that will shape your future. You’ll be part of an academically excellent community where your ideas drive your college experience. The people you learn alongside will bring perspectives and life experiences from across the globe, which will prepare you for success.Through academic instruction led by some of the world’s top professors, you’ll master the art of learning while being part of the university’s most significant and meaningful endeavors. Ultimately, you’ll graduate with the tools and mindset you need to live a personally fulfilling life. Majors and degree programsWith high-quality undergraduate and graduate degree programs led by an expert faculty in highly ranked colleges and schools, students become master learners through an interdisciplinary approach to instruction, capable of learning anything.Undergraduate degreesGraduate programs Rankings and factsAt ASU, you can customize how you learn, what you learn and the pace at which you learn so that you can design an academic experience that is uniquely your own. This innovative approach has the world taking notice — with learners joining us from around the globe — and national and international rankings placing ASU as a top destination for forward-thinking students and scholars. #1 in the U.S. for innovationahead of MIT and Stanford, according to U.S. News & World Report, 2016-26.#2 in U.S. for employabilityASU ranks No. 2 in the U.S. among public universities, for the fourth straight year, in the GEURS survey of employers. #1 in the U.S. and top 10 in the worldfor global impact in research, outreach and stewardship, according to Times Higher Education.194,000+students enroll at ASU annually.800+undergraduate and graduate degree programs for students to choose from, including accelerated degrees, dual majors, and accelerated master’s pathways.18-to-1student to faculty ratio to ensure that students receive the individualized support they need to achieve success and master the art of learning. Customized learning On-campus students learn on one of ASU’s four campuses in the greater Phoenix metropolitan region, in locations across Arizona, and at centers in Los Angeles and Washington, D.C. With six start dates throughout the year, students can earn an ASU degree by enrolling in one of the 300+ undergraduate and graduate degrees offered 100% online from one the nation’s leaders in online education. ASU’s most valuable digital learning tools are available to anyone, at any age, many at no cost. Experience the quality of a top-tier research university, from anywhere in the world. Colleges and schoolsFrom engineering, journalism and business to sustainability, nursing, education and beyond, ASU offers more than a dozen colleges and schools you can choose from as your academic home.Each school offers specialized programming and advising, research opportunities, and an outstanding academic experience designed to prepare you for the next step in your life. And if you’re not sure what you want to study, we have programs to help you figure it out.ASU’s college and schools Barrett, The Honors College at ASUBarrett, The Honors College at ASU is a selective, residential college that recruits academically outstanding undergraduates across the nation. Named the “best honors college in the nation,” this residential community has more National Merit Scholars than MIT, Duke, Brown, Stanford or UCLA, and Barrett students benefit from a $12 million endowment used exclusively to support honors students and their projects.barretthonors.asu.edu/ ASU students learn alongside professors, mentors and researchers across the university as they explore innovative ideas and make groundbreaking discoveries with some of the brightest minds in academia. Academic leadership The university is led by a community of creative and impassioned scholars and higher education innovators. In our research and scholarship, we advance new knowledge that benefits the world. In our teaching, mentorship and design of learning experiences, we prepare our students to achieve their goals and contribute their talents to an ever-changing, globally connected world.
